rule: Unknown means unknown. Do not promote guesses, community speculation, old Catalyst behavior, or OSRS League mechanics into Equilibrium facts without a source.

items.known: Seven Relic tiers exist. Tier 1 is public.
items.expected_update: Jagex says daily reveals begin 2026-07-28 and continue through launch on 2026-08-10.

items.known: Eight combat Blessing tiers exist, following Order/Balance/Chaos choices; tiers 4 and 8 resolve into god-aligned effects based on prior choices.
missing: how quickly each region can complete the tree

items.known: The League includes accelerated progression and passive Relic-tier bonuses.

items.known: Misthalin and Havenhythe start unlocked. Karamja unlocks after the first task milestone. Players then choose three elective regions.
missing: exact milestone/point/task thresholds for all three elective region unlocks

items.known: Unlocking a region auto-completes many quests to expose its core content, with Prifddinas and Menaphos given as examples.

Catalyst's task taxonomy grouped both City of Um and Fort Forinthry under Misthalin. Equilibrium explicitly places Daemonheim in Forinthry/Wilderness. We use those as the working planner mappings without presenting Catalyst locality labels as new-League confirmation.

official Equilibrium confirmation of the Fort Forinthry locality

items.known: Task values are Easy 10, Medium 30, Hard 80, Elite 200, Master 400.
